## Standard 2.1: the uniform rules

IMPLEMENTING.md U1 to U16 (vendored from serialize v2.1.0). U2 landed with 2.1.0; the rest are unaudited against this port.

### audit U1 and U3 to U16 against this port, and fix each rule it breaks

For each rule the port breaks: a unit test red now, the fix, the test green (no real time, no sockets, zero analyzer diagnostics). Rules already kept get a one-line note. Known starting point: U14 (a public fail(reason), and an object error value outside the closed list must latch rejected; serializeObject still latches the caller's own value as given) and U16 (the two findings below). Done when: every rule U1 to U16 is noted kept or has a landed test plus fix on green main.

## Audit findings, 2026-10-27

The cross-port security and correctness audit's findings for this port (AUDIT-LEDGER.md, heading luau). Reproducers are in /Volumes/nova/ai/rowan/working/serialize-love/audit2/serialize.luau/test/audit/ (targeted_test.luau, hostile_test.luau). Each fix runs its reproducer first and confirms it fails.

### M: a non-integer bits parameter is accepted (U16 declaration validation)

serializeBits with a fractional bit count is accepted, moves the bit position to a fraction, reads wrong values and traps later. Reproducer: targeted_test.luau TestC_FractionalBitsParam and TestC2_FractionalBitsConsequences. Done when: TestC* pass: every stream raises on a non-integer bits declaration before any bit moves, with a unit test.

From: AUDIT-LEDGER.md, luau, M

### L: the precomputed compressed_float validator is fooled by a 2^32 wrap (U16)

serializeCompressedFloatPrecomputed accepts bogus constants whose width check wraps at 2^32. Reproducer: targeted_test.luau TestD_PrecomputedBogusConstants. Done when: TestD passes: bogus precomputed constants raise on every stream, with a unit test.

From: AUDIT-LEDGER.md, luau, L

### L: serializeUint128 read into an empty holder {} raises

A read into {} raises instead of assigning the value. Reproducer: targeted_test.luau TestA_Uint128ReadEmptyHolder. Done when: TestA passes, with a unit test.

From: AUDIT-LEDGER.md, luau, L

### L: a number written to serializeUint64 or serializeBits64 raises a raw Luau error, not the documented misuse text

Writing a plain number where an integer is required surfaces the integer library's own error instead of a serialize: raise naming the rule (DESIGN.md (g)). Reproducer: targeted_test.luau TestB_Uint64WriteNumber. Done when: TestB passes: the raise names the rule in serialize's own text, with a unit test.

From: AUDIT-LEDGER.md, luau, L

### perf: the reader is about 3.4x slower than the writer (bit at a time)

A separate performance job, not a correctness fix. Reproducer: targeted_test.luau TestF_ReaderSpeed. Timing runs go only on amd-3 with nothing else running; never trade read-path speed for a check without measuring it. Done when: the reader is measured on amd-3 within an agreed ratio of the writer, before and after numbers recorded.

From: AUDIT-LEDGER.md, luau, L (perf card)
